```{r DMP, all cause}
analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont$variables=analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont$variables %>% 
  mutate(Age_stop=RIDAGEYR+(permth_int/12))

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale <- svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(RIDAGEYR, Age_stop, mortstat) ~ as.factor(quartile)+RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont) %>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) 

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_p_trend <- svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(RIDAGEYR, Age_stop, mortstat) ~ quartile+RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont) %>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) 

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_p_trend_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_p_trend$table_body %>% filter(term=="quartile") %>% select(p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_p_trend_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale$table_body %>% filter(term=="as.factor(quartile)2"|term=="as.factor(quartile)3"|term=="as.factor(quartile)4") %>% 
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>% 
  mutate(
    Metabolite="DMP",
    Outcome="All cause",
    HR=round(estimate, digits=2),
         CI_low=round(conf.low, digits=2),
         CI_high=round(conf.high, digits=2),
    HR_CI=paste0(HR, " (", CI_low, ", ", CI_high, ")")) %>% 
  select(Metabolite, Outcome, term, HR_CI)

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_final=bind_cols( all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_numbers, all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_p_trend_numbers)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_final

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_final_wide=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_final %>% pivot_wider(names_from=term, values_from=HR_CI) %>% select(Outcome, Metabolite, `as.factor(quartile)2`,`as.factor(quartile)3`,`as.factor(quartile)4`, p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_age_time_scale_final_wide


```
